subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should the WhatsApp phone-code/515 recovery work be folded into the active generic channel-auth phone-code PR, or tracked as a separate WhatsApp-owned 515 finalization fix?
rationale: The remaining work crosses public CLI/plugin auth surface, persisted WhatsApp auth-state classification, and live recovery behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Require Recovery Proof In The Phone-Code PR
options.body: Keep the generic phone-code PR as the implementation lane, but require live WhatsApp proof that accepted pairing no longer needs a gateway restart and that QR-linked sessions still upgrade safely.

options.title: Split A WhatsApp-Owned 515 Fix
options.body: Leave the phone-code API decision to the linked PRs and open or keep a narrower WhatsApp recovery task focused only on restart-free 515 finalization and partial credentials.

options.title: Pause Until Dependency Behavior Is Proven
options.body: Keep this issue open without implementation work until Baileys pairing-code behavior and browser metadata requirements are proven in a live smoke.

recommendation.title: Require Recovery Proof In The Phone-Code PR
recommendation.body: Keep the generic phone-code PR as the implementation lane, but require live WhatsApp proof that accepted pairing no longer needs a gateway restart and that QR-linked sessions still upgrade safely.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans public CLI, plugin API, docs, and auth/session boundaries where the history and active PR reviews point to steipete as the best routing owner.
